Given the clinical context and the typical presentation of a Morgagni's hernia, the opacity is consistent with the herniation of abdominal contents, specifically the liver, into the thoracic cavity. This is a rare but characteristic finding in Morgagni's hernia, especially since it is typically right-sided due to the presence of the liver.
